lines.en: I stand behind a tree. The tree is thinner than I.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有影子移动。
lines.en: I make no sound. Only my shadow moves.
Step by step. Never fast.
My arms hang past my knees.
I pass through fog. It does not part.
Every bird in the wood has stopped.
I walk along the treeline's shade.
A white face appears between trunks.

lines.zh: 我消失了一下，出现在前面。
lines.en: I vanish and appear further on.
I have no face, only white.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草没有声音。
lines.en: The grass makes no sound where I pass.
I move between the tree trunks.

lines.zh: 我走过落叶，没有一声响。
lines.en: I cross the leaves without a sound.

lines.zh: 我很高，可树枝挡不住我。
lines.en: I am very tall, yet the branches do not stop me.
Step by step, and I never run.

lines.zh: 我沿着细长森林的边界走。
lines.en: I walk the border of the slender forest.

lines.zh: 我的影子在树干上折成几段。
lines.en: My shadow breaks into pieces on the trunks.
I pass through the mist, and it does not stir.
As I walk, the trees withdraw to either side.
There is only my white in this wood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，不做多余的事。
lines.en: I come closer slowly, doing nothing extra.
I stop behind a tree, half shown.
I walk the same way you are going.
I stand like a pillar.

lines.zh: 我被人看见的时候，就走开。
lines.en: When seen, I withdraw.
This Slender Forest is mine.
I tilt my head slightly.
The wind goes around me.
I am reading the breath you just took.

lines.zh: 书页被拿走的时候，我醒了。
lines.en: When the pages were taken, I woke.
My clothes have no folds.
Behind the tree, I have not moved.
Light passes through me as through trees.
You search for me. I am behind you.
I stand, and my face is blank.
I hold still like a flagpole.
Mist gathers around me.
There is no expression to read.
I lower my head toward the deep wood.

lines.zh: 纸页在我脚下的叶子间。
lines.en: Pages lie among the leaves at my feet.
I wait for you to come to me.
The wind passes through me as through cloth.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以林子里很静。
lines.en: I do not breathe, so the wood is silent.
My arms are far too long.
I count the trees, one by one.
My head is bowed, yet my face turns to you.
Turn your body around.
You are in my forest.
I see your eyes.
You took the pages.
Each time you look back, I am closer.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我一直在笑。
lines.en: No mouth, yet I am always smiling.
Do not look at me. Watch the path.
Thirty seconds and you are out.
This fog is mine.
Count the trunks and you will still be lost.
Your torch is dying.
I am in no hurry at all.
Blink one more time.
You have walked a long way.
There is no exit from this wood.
Look back, and I am right there.

lines.zh: 你手里的纸页是从我这儿拿的。
lines.en: The page in your hand came from me.

lines.zh: 那上面写的东西，你不该读。
lines.en: You should not have read what it says.
I say nothing, for there is nothing to say.
You hold your breath — I hear it.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树刚才不在这儿。
lines.en: That tree behind you was not here before.
Can you remember my face?

lines.zh: 你跑不动的时候，我会走得很快。
lines.en: When you can no longer run, I walk very fast.

lines.zh: 你听见树叶响，可没有风。
lines.en: You hear leaves move, and there is no wind.
Further on, the mist is thicker.
I would like you to stay.

lines.zh: 你的影子跟着我，比跟着你久。
lines.en: Your shadow has followed me longer than you.
Your blade went through.
I did not retreat, yet I am displeased.
A line cracks my white face.
The fog thins a little.
I am still in this forest.
This wound is no wound.
You surprised me.
My clothes are cut open.
Look at me once more.
You struck me, and I withdrew.
The white shape thinned.
I vanished from before your eyes.
The mist takes me back in.
I will return in fifteen seconds.
Your hand is still shaking.
That brought me to a halt.
The wood went quiet for an instant.

lines.zh: 你听见的只是自己的心跳。
lines.en: You only heard your own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我并没有离开这片林子。
lines.en: I have not left this wood.
How many pages of that book did you read?
I know the smell of paper.
Bring it over to me.
Which page did you reach?
Read one more page and I come.
I do not eat. I want those pages.
Are the pages glowing?
Put them back in the structure.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，属于林子。
lines.en: What you hold belongs to the forest.
Give it, and one fewer person vanishes.
You hold up a page.
Reading it has a price.
You have already read it.
The words on it will follow you.
Putting it down will not help.
I take no offerings — only people.
The paper trembles in your hand.
Have you counted how many pages remain?

lines.zh: 你可以继续找，也可以停。
lines.en: You may keep searching, or stop.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都不是白给的。
lines.en: Nothing here comes for free.

lines.zh: 你穿过我，像穿过一片林子。
lines.en: You pass through me as if through a grove of trees.
I have no weight.
Your hand met air.
Do not lean on the trunks.
I did not move; you retreated.
The twig you broke was loud.
The fog clings to you.
My sleeve brushed your face.
The space here is narrow.
Stand in the middle of the path.
You did not strike anything solid.

lines.zh: 我的手已经在你肩上了。
lines.en: My hand is already on your shoulder.
To touch me is to feel cold.
After that touch, the wood changed.
You stepped back, but the trees did not.
I stoop, my face very close.
There is a little warmth in you.
The mist rings us together.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过了我的袖口。
lines.en: Your hand passed through my sleeve.
I did not move away.
That has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 细长森林的纸页，我守着。
lines.en: I keep the pages of the slender woods.
This forest is full enough.
You have stayed too long.
I collect only pages.
Do not raise your eyes to me.
The fog would part us.
I have always been alone.
Go, and do not look back.
You may stay. I permit it.
This wood is room enough for two to walk.
I will follow you without a sound.
Do not look back, and pretend I am not here.

lines.zh: 纸页留给你，代价也留给你。
lines.en: The pages are yours, and so is the price.
We walk until the mist clears.
You may let go of the trunk.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后的时候，你该安心。
lines.en: When I stand behind you, you should be at ease.
All the trees here are mine.

lines.zh: 天不会亮，但我们还要走。
lines.en: Day will not break, but we walk on.
This page is mine.
I need not bend at all.
My fingers are long enough.
This page fell to the ground.

lines.zh: 纸角卷起来了，我按平它。
lines.en: The page corner is curling; I press it flat.
The corner of the page is curled.
There is little on the ground.
What did you just drop?
I put it back into the book.
This is not yours to keep.

lines.zh: 纸页在我手里没有重量。
lines.en: Pages weigh nothing in my hand.
I hand it to you, and you read.
All the pages on the ground are mine to keep.
I picked up the sheet you dropped.
The words move about on their own.
Rain has blurred the writing.
I can read it. You need not ask.
This page should not be here.
I push it back into the tree hollow.
You still have the other pages to find.
You have been marked.
I saw that shape.
Run. Do not stop.
The fog is drawing in.
You will not leave this forest.
Your shadow is long.
This time, I do not let go.
What number have you reached?
The whole wood is giving way.

lines.zh: 细长森林的纸页，全是我留的。
lines.en: Every page in the slender forest is mine.
I am by the tree behind you.
The mist has sealed the other paths.
Your pages are still short a few.

lines.zh: 树影一移，我开始跟着你。
lines.en: The tree shadows shift; I start to follow.

lines.zh: 你听见的声音不是叶子。
lines.en: What you heard was not leaves.

lines.zh: 这片林子的边界你走不到。
lines.en: You will not reach the edge of this wood.
Your breathing is in my ears.
I count every step you run.
You chose a poor direction.

lines.zh: 细长森林里，我总在前面。
lines.en: In the slender forest, I am always ahead.
This slender forest is mine.
I am behind the trunk.
I have closed some of the distance.

lines.zh: 树林里只有你的脚步在响。
lines.en: Only your footsteps sound in these woods.
I am on the path ahead.
The fog keeps sinking lower.
You counted a tree wrongly.
I am already where you are running.
Thirty more steps.
I wait for you to stop on your own.
This very moment.
Do not turn your head.
One step carries me past two trees.
Run, and I grow faster.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在雾里很清楚。
lines.en: Your footprints are clear in the mist.
I stand before you, unmoving.
There are no trees where you are retreating.
When I reach out, the distance is gone.
Your eyes are searching for a way.
The mist is counting for you.

lines.zh: 我不急，这里的时间很慢。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. Time is slow here.
Listen — the leaves again.
Three trees between us.
You have put your back to a tree.
This is the last tree.
Something has you.
So quiet not a sound is heard.

lines.zh: 你的视野被一片白盖住。
lines.en: White covers your sight.
I close on your throat.
You are dragged into the tree shadow.
No blood. Only quiet pain.
I let go, and you remain.
Your fall is muffled.
I am right at your ear.
Thirty seconds have passed.
Leave now.
My hand comes from behind the trunk.
You are pressed against the bark.
I lift you up and set you down.
Your feet left the ground for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的手从树干后伸出来。
lines.en: My hand reaches out from behind the trunk.
I let go, and you slide down.
Your sight goes white.

lines.zh: 我的手指圈住了你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers close around your wrist.
The tree shadows cover you both.
I withdraw, and the mist closes.
You hear pages turning.

lines.zh: 这一片林子安静了下来。
lines.en: This stretch of wood has fallen quiet.
The pages were taken.
Fog begins in the forest.
I stand behind you.
You have that effect now.
I was not here before.

lines.zh: 树与树之间多了个影子。
lines.en: A shadow appears between the trees.
I saw you open the book.
This is not a dream.
I take shape from the fog.
I came because you called me.
The white face first, then the hands.
Do you hear the wind stop?

lines.zh: 书页被撕开后，我站在树间。
lines.en: Once the page was torn, I stand among the trees.

lines.zh: 雾里多了一个高瘦的影子。
lines.en: There is one more tall thin shape in the mist.

lines.zh: 我站在最里面的那棵树后。
lines.en: I stand behind the innermost tree.
The leaves fell silent first.
I walk out from deep in the wood.
A page on the ground turns itself.
One tree's shadow looks wrong.
The wind stopped when I appeared.
This wood was not meant to have anyone in it.
I stand exactly between two trees.

lines.zh: 我的白色在雾里很显眼。
lines.en: My white is very visible in the mist.
You have come here again.

lines.zh: 这一片的树都是细长的。
lines.en: The trees in this part are all slender.
I slowly separate myself from the background.
Fire rolls through the fog; I retreat into the trees.
Firelight shows me plainly.
I did not land.

lines.zh: 你掉进了林子下面的坑。
lines.en: You fell into the pit beneath the wood.
Water does not stop me. It only slows me.

lines.zh: 水漫过你的膝盖，我没有湿。
lines.en: Water rose to your knees, and I stayed dry.
The blast scatters the fog.

lines.zh: 爆响惊起了整片林的鸟。
lines.en: The blast startles every bird in the wood.

lines.zh: 箭从我这里穿过去，扎在树上。
lines.en: The arrow passes and sticks in a tree.

lines.zh: 你的箭穿过了我，插在树上。
lines.en: Your arrow passed through me into a tree.
This light keeps me from hiding.

lines.zh: 这股力量把我推了出去。
lines.en: That force pushed me out.

lines.zh: 我不需要进食，只需要注视。
lines.en: I need no food. Only watching.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，从来没饿过。
lines.en: I have waited long and never hungered.
Lightning lights the whole forest.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了林子，我暂时看不见了。
lines.en: Lightning lit the wood and I was briefly blind.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有我。
lines.en: No trees in the void, and no me.
This place is worse than the void.
